entry_points: creation, transition, listing and cancellation regressions
security_boundaries: personId does not replace org filter
tenant_boundaries: org condition asserted in list and cancellation

findings.evidence: Added cancellation tenant and NULL-org system path regressions.
findings.impact: Locks in tenant defense against assignment-ID cancellation.
findings.fix: Keep cancellation org-scoped for every authenticated path.

security_boundaries: privileged roles or bound worker only
plan must be approved/dispatched and not shadow
tenant_boundaries: all keys include orgId; receipt cannot broaden via OR
failure_paths: ambiguous keys, missing links, unauthorized worker, illegal transitions, duplicate feedback and stale assignment states fail closed
tests: execution feedback advancement and canonical receipt tests

findings.evidence: Advisory lock is acquired after initial candidate/state reads.
findings.impact: Two requests may initially read the same state, then serialize; later CAS and row locks prevent duplicate or invalid advancement.
findings.fix: Keep CAS guards; optional cleanup could acquire advisory lock before first read for less contention.

security_boundaries: HTTP timestamp cannot create device measurement; real source requires independent pre-existing receipt and independent approval
tenant_boundaries: all linked facts must match org
failure_paths: missing/mismatched evidence yields unknown rather than real
tests: canonical receipt workflow and shadow feedback specs

security_boundaries: client cannot overwrite recorded facts or force illegal state
failure_paths: invalid time/metric/status fails before write; end before start rejected
tests: execution service and canonical receipt tests

security_boundaries: outbox event preserves tenant and provenance metadata
metrics failure does not hide transition
tenant_boundaries: receipt update can be tenant or legacy NULL-org system path; list scopes to org plus explicit legacy NULL; cancellation now constrained to actor org or NULL-org system path
failure_paths: unplannable failures publish events without fake replan trigger

findings.evidence: cancelForAssignments updated only by assignmentId and status, without org predicate.
findings.impact: A reused or forged assignment ID supplied to the reusable domain API could cancel another tenant execution.
findings.fix: Constrain updates to actor primaryOrgId; NULL-org path remains explicit for no-actor system callers and is regression-tested.

findings.evidence: A FAILED execution without explicit deviationType is derived as DEVICE_FAILURE.
findings.impact: A person- or safety-caused failure could be attributed to the device if caller omits type.
findings.fix: Require explicit failure cause at UI/API layer or add a generic execution-failure deviation type in a contract migration.

security_boundaries: any authenticated role; no anonymous access
tenant_boundaries: actor primaryOrgId forwarded; service fails closed without org
failure_paths: invalid numeric query is normalized to bounded default

contracts: missing facts not counted as zero
tenant_boundaries: primaryOrgId mandatory and included in SQL where
failure_paths: limit/window outside bounds clamp; limit reached adds explicit coverage note

findings.evidence: Window filters by row createdAt and uses application now().
findings.impact: Late-loaded executions are grouped by ingest time, and cross-node clock differences can move the window boundary.
findings.fix: Document ingest-time semantics or migrate to database-time/window event time when historical replay matters.
